folder component

Web·by @designbyaron·2026-08-20·inspora page·original post

What it is

Folder component: Rankine's landing page turns its process into a stack of physical file folders - as you scroll, full-width blue folder sheets (numbered red-stamp tabs '01 CONNECT', '02 SECURE', '03 DEPLOY', '04 AMPLIFY') pile up like a manila-folder stack, each tab peeking above the previous sheet; the top sheet carries the pitch 'We Don't Sell You AI. We Do The Work.'; hero above: 'Unleash The TRUE POTENTIAL Of Your Credit Union'.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-20%
Page top: hero headline with 'TRUE POTENTIAL' stamped in red outline; the folder stack sits below showing Connect/Secure/Deploy/Amplify rows expanded like an accordion list.
20-50%
Scroll: the sections collapse upward and convert into folder tabs - each blue sheet slides up, its stamped tab (01 CONNECT ... 04 AMPLIFY) docking into the stack with perspective gaps.
50-80%
The stack compresses into a neat deck of 4 staggered tabs on the big blue front sheet with white headline.
80-100%
Tabs can be pulled: a sheet slides down/forward to reveal its section copy ('Deploy' paragraph visible); scroll continues to footer CTA.

Mechanics

trigger
scroll (sticky stack) + tab click
elements
folder sheets (blue, rounded, tab cutouts), stamped tab labels, section content
properties
translateY per sheet, scale/gap compression, tab stacking order, sheet pull-out
timing
scroll-linked (scrub); tab open 500ms
easing
scrub linear; ease-out on tab
loop
no

Build prompt

Build a scroll-driven folder stack. Section 200vh with a sticky viewport. Inside, 4 folder sheets (full-width, #4F46E5 blue, 24px top radius) each with a small tab shape on its top edge (trapezoid cutout, offset progressively right) labeled with a red outline stamp '01 CONNECT' etc (11px, letterspaced, rotated -2deg). Progress 0: sheets laid out as an open accordion (expanded rows with title + paragraph). On scroll, each sheet translates up and docks into a stack - sheet i stops at y = i*56px so all four tabs peek in a staggered deck over the front sheet, which shows 'We Don't Sell You AI. We Do The Work.' (56px white, tight). Use scroll scrub (e.g. GSAP ScrollTrigger, sticky pin). Clicking a docked tab slides that sheet down-forward 120px revealing its paragraph (500ms ease-out) and pushes siblings' z-order behind. Above the component: hero 'Unleash The [TRUE POTENTIAL] Of Your Credit Union' with the bracketed words in red outline stamp style; red 'Book a Demo' button in nav.
